subject: QBR runway: forecast sprint, account briefs & confidence checklist
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@stratusretail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratusretail.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR: consolidation ask — Stratus account brief + confidence levels

Diego,

Thanks for flagging the QBR timeline. Attaching the account-level ARR export and a short list of outstanding procurement items. For the QBR we need a short one-page brief and a confidence tag for the forecast (High/Med/Low) from your side. Procurement is tracking SOW redlines — Michelle will follow up separately.

Can you confirm whether you can deliver the brief and a mutually agreeable forecast by EOW next week? If not, what would you need from us to accelerate?

Attachments: 20261201_Stratus_account_brief.pdf, ARR_export_202612.csv (see drive)

— Jamie
Head of Partnerships
Stratus Retail
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@stratusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: consolidation ask — Stratus account brief + confidence levels

Jamie — thanks. We can own the consolidation work on our end and deliver the one-page brief + confidence matrix. Proposed plan:

- Quick intake call Wed 12/2 (15m) to confirm assumptions and target ARR definition
- Internal forecast sprint Thurs–Fri: we’ll pull per-region usage, contract timings, expected renewals
- Deliverables: one-page account brief (PDF), forecast_rollforward_2026Q4.csv, and a confidence checklist

Do these milestones work for you? I’ve attached a draft mutual_action_plan_stratus.xlsx so procurement and sales can align on milestones.

If procurement needs anything immediate (e.g., T&Cs), loop Michelle and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: FW: QBR intake — sprint checklist & owner assignments

Folks — forwarding Jamie’s note. This is the sprint scope for QBR prep (ETA: deliverables on Mon 12/7):

Sprint checklist
- Owner: Marissa — update the one-page brief with latest usage delta and product notes
- Owner: Ben — consolidate bookings, include any committed overages and adjust run-rate
- Owner: Lauren — validate forecast inputs (billing dates, PO timing) and draft confidence tags (H/M/L)
- Diego — compile and produce forecast_rollforward_2026Q4.csv and final PDF

Key asks for each brief (one paragraph each): current ARR/run-rate, renewal window, top risk, recommended mitigant, confidence level.

OKR tie-in: this activity maps to Sales Q4 OKR 1.2 (increase forecast accuracy to 85%). Please update the shared Drive doc as you go: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBRPrep

I’m scheduling a 15m sync Friday morning to review the drafts. If you hit blockers (procurement redlines, legal asks), call them out in comments.

Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jamie Park <jamie.park@stratusretail.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: QBR intake — sprint checklist & owner assignments

Uploaded the updated account brief and the forecast rollforward; see attached. Quick notes:

- Confidence: Medium — procurement still flagging payment terms; Michelle asked for a 30-day PO confirmation which would push recognition into Jan
- Risk: potential shortfall of $120k if PO slips past 12/31; we have a mitigant (temporary discounted burst capacity) but need exec approval for credit note
- Action: Ben, can you confirm committed booking offsets? Diego — please add the final numbers to the QBR deck.

Attachments: forecast_rollforward_2026Q4.csv

— Marissa
